publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: The first native camera frame is real but very dark
record.method: OV5640 sensor capture into guarded DRAM and post-run hash controls
record.observation: A genuine 640 × 480 UYVY frame replaced the prefilled capture buffer with no unchanged sentinel rows and intact guards. Its luma ranged from 2 to 6; test-pattern mode was disabled.
record.limits: This initial single-frame checkpoint establishes DMA capture, not usable exposure, recognizable scene content, Camera preview or JPEG saving. The later preview and saved-photo milestones have their own records. No new post-run fsck was executed in this read-only trial; prior fsck plus byte-identical data hashes supplied its cleanliness control.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: The first native camera frame is real but very dark
rows: Eight hashes unchanged; no guest writes
exhibits.interpretation: Buffer replacement proves a transfer occurred. Scene quality and application integration require further observations.
